newsitem.title: USA: Profit Recovery acquires ShapsGroup Inc.
newsitem.headline: Profit Recovery acquires ShapsGroup Inc.

text.p: Profit Recovery Group International said on Monday it acquired ShapsGroup Inc.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.
ShapsGroup will operate a wholly owned subsidiary of the Profit Recovery Group.
Profit Recovery, provider of accounts payable and other audit recovery services, conducts its operations throughout the United States and in Australia, Belgium and other countries.
ShapsGroup, with approximately $2.7 million in annual revenues, is an accounts payable recovery audit firm based in Los Altos, California.
